name: 5-HO-MET
summary: 5-HO-MET, also known as 5-hydroxy-N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-hydroxytryptamine families related to bufotenin (5-HO-DMT). It is the derivative of bufotenin in which one of the two methyl groups at the amine has been extended to an ethyl group. The drug is also an analogue of methylethyltryptamine (MET), 4-HO-MET (metocin), and 5-MeO-MET.

uses.text: 5-HO-MET was reported as a novel designer drug in Canada in 2025.

pharmacology.en: Like bufotenine, it is thought to act on serotonin receptors, including the 5-HT2A receptor that classic psychedelics work on.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和蟾蜍色胺一樣作用於血清素受體，包括經典迷幻藥作用的5-HT2A受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和蟾蜍色胺一样作用于血清素受体，包括经典迷幻药作用的5-HT2A受体。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is bufotenine with one of its two methyl groups lengthened to an ethyl group. Bufotenine is found in toad skin secretions and in seeds used to make the snuff yopo.
fact.zh: 它是把蟾蜍色胺兩個甲基中的一個延長為乙基。蟾蜍色胺存在於蟾蜍的皮膚分泌物中，也存在於用來製作鼻煙「yopo」的種子裡。
fact.zhHans: 它是把蟾蜍色胺两个甲基中的一个延长为乙基。蟾蜍色胺存在于蟾蜍的皮肤分泌物中，也存在于用来制作鼻烟「yopo」的种子里。
